champions.name: Olaf
champions.title: the Berserker

abilities.P: Berserker Rage: gain AS as HP decreases
abilities.Q: Undertow: throw axe skillshot. Pick up reduces CD. Slow on hit.
abilities.W: Vicious Strikes: bonus AS + lifesteal. More healing at low HP.
abilities.E: Reckless Swing: point-click true damage (costs HP to cast)
abilities.R: Ragnarok: passive bonus armor/MR. Active: immune to CC + bonus AD. Lose passive resists during.

champions.playstyle: Unkillable berserker. R = CC immune. Low HP = more AS. E true damage ignores armor.

champions.name: Orianna
champions.title: the Lady of Clockwork

abilities.P: Clockwork Windup: AAs deal stacking bonus magic damage on same target
abilities.Q: Command: Attack: move ball to location dealing magic damage in path
abilities.W: Command: Dissonance: AoE on ball dealing magic + speed zone (ally MS / enemy slow)
abilities.E: Command: Protect: ball attaches to ally, shielding + dealing magic damage in path. Passive armor/MR.
abilities.R: Command: Shockwave: AoE pull toward ball center + massive magic damage. THE teamfight ult.

champions.playstyle: Ball-control mage. Attach ball to diver → R Shockwave for game-winning 5-man CC combo.

champions.name: Ornn
champions.title: the Fire Below the Mountain

abilities.P: Living Forge: can buy items from anywhere. Upgrades allies' items to Masterwork at levels 9/12/14.
abilities.Q: Volcanic Rupture: ground fissure dealing damage + slow. Creates pillar at end.
abilities.W: Bellows Breath: breathe fire in cone. Last tick applies Brittle (bonus CC duration + %max HP magic on next CC).
abilities.E: Searing Charge: dash. If hits terrain/pillar = AoE knockup.
abilities.R: Call of the Forge God: summon massive ram. Recast: headbutt ram back → AoE knockup + Brittle.

champions.playstyle: Team-scaling tank. Upgrades allies' items. R massive long-range engage. Brittle = bonus damage.

champions.name: Pantheon
champions.title: the Unbreakable Spear

abilities.P: Mortal Will: every 5 abilities/AAs empowers next ability
abilities.Q: Comet Spear: tap for thrust, hold for throw. Empowered: bonus damage + slow.
abilities.W: Shield Vault: point-click dash + stun on arrival
abilities.E: Aegis Assault: block all damage from one direction for 1.5s. Final slam deals damage. Empowered: extended duration.
abilities.R: Grand Starfall: semi-global: leap into the sky and crash down at target location. AoE damage on landing.

champions.playstyle: Early-game bully. W stun → empowered Q for burst. E blocks all frontal damage. R to roam.

champions.name: Poppy
champions.title: Keeper of the Hammer

abilities.P: Iron Ambassador: AA throws buckler shield. Picking it up grants shield.
abilities.Q: Hammer Shock: AoE ground slam + delayed pop for %max HP damage
abilities.W: Steadfast Presence: passive bonus armor/MR at low HP. Active: create anti-dash zone (grounds enemies).
abilities.E: Heroic Charge: dash to enemy, pin to wall = stun
abilities.R: Keeper's Verdict: charge hammer → knockup (tap) or mega knockback sending enemies to base (hold)

champions.playstyle: Anti-dash tank. W stops all dashes. E wall stun. R removes threats from fights.

champions.name: Pyke
champions.title: the Bloodharbor Ripper

abilities.P: Gift of the Drowned Ones: bonus HP converts to AD. Regen: recover damage taken while hidden.
abilities.Q: Bone Skewer: charge → hook enemy toward you. Tap to stab.
abilities.W: Ghostwater Dive: stealth + massive MS boost. Reveal at close range.
abilities.E: Phantom Undertow: dash leaving phantom. Phantom returns to Pyke, stunning enemies in path.
abilities.R: Death from Below: blink to X-mark dealing execute damage. Resets on kill. Shares full gold to assisting ally.

champions.playstyle: Assassin support. Hook → stun → R execute = gold for both you and ADC. Snowball machine.

champions.name: Rakan
champions.title: the Charmer

abilities.P: Fey Feathers: occasionally gain shield from passive. AA heals if near ally.
abilities.Q: Gleaming Quill: skillshot damage. If it hits, get heal aura after delay (near ally = instant heal).
abilities.W: Grand Entrance: dash to location → AoE knockup after brief delay
abilities.E: Battle Dance: dash to ally champion granting shield. 2 charges if Xayah is ally.
abilities.R: The Quickness: gain MS + charm enemies you touch. Combos with W for engage.

champions.playstyle: Engage enchanter. R+W dive for AoE charm+knockup. E to dash back to carry for safety.

champions.name: Rammus
champions.title: the Armordillo

abilities.P: Spiked Shell: AAs deal bonus magic damage scaling with armor
abilities.Q: Powerball: roll into a ball gaining MS. Collide with enemy = AoE knockback + slow.
abilities.W: Defensive Ball Curl: gain bonus armor/MR. AAs against you deal magic damage back.
abilities.E: Frenzying Taunt: point-click taunt forcing enemy to AA you. Gain AS during.
abilities.R: Soaring Slam: leap to location dealing AoE magic damage + aftershock. Creates tremors slowing.

champions.playstyle: Anti-AD tank. Taunt carries into you → they kill themselves on reflected damage. Powerball for engage.

champions.name: Rell
champions.title: the Iron Maiden

abilities.P: Break the Mold: steal armor/MR from enemies hit by AAs/abilities
abilities.Q: Shattering Strike: stab forward. Break shields. Heal if hits champion.
abilities.W: W1: Ferromancy - Crash Down: dismount → leap + AoE knockup + gain shield. Slow after. W2: mount → gain MS.
abilities.E: Attract and Repel: tether to ally. Recast: stun enemies between you and ally.
abilities.R: Magnet Storm: pull all nearby enemies toward you repeatedly for 2s.

champions.playstyle: AoE CC tank. W knockup engage → R pulls enemies together → E stun with ally.

champions.name: Renekton
champions.title: the Butcher of the Sands

abilities.P: Reign of Anger: generate Fury from AAs/abilities. At 50 Fury, abilities are empowered.
abilities.Q: Cull the Meek: AoE slash + heal. Empowered: more damage + more healing.
abilities.W: Ruthless Predator: AA reset with 2 hits + stun. Empowered: 3 hits + longer stun + armor shred.
abilities.E: Slice and Dice: dash through enemies. Can recast for second dash. Empowered: armor shred.
abilities.R: Dominus: gain bonus HP + AoE magic damage per second for 15s. Generates Fury.

champions.playstyle: Lane bully. E in → W stun → Q heal → E out. Dominates early game. Falls off late.

champions.name: Rengar
champions.title: the Pridestalker

abilities.P: Unseen Predator: from brush/R, leap to target. Generate Ferocity stacks. At 4, next ability is empowered.
abilities.Q: Savagery: AA reset + slash. Empowered: massive damage + AS.
abilities.W: Battle Roar: AoE magic damage. Empowered: heal based on damage taken (cleanse CC).
abilities.E: Bola Strike: skillshot root on empowered. Normal: slow.
abilities.R: Thrill of the Hunt: stealth + reveal nearest enemy. Leap from stealth = guaranteed crit.

champions.playstyle: Brush assassin. R stealth → leap → one-shot. Ferocity stacking for empowered abilities.

champions.name: Riven
champions.title: the Exile

abilities.P: Runic Blade: abilities charge AA (up to 3). Each empowered AA deals bonus physical.
abilities.Q: Broken Wings: 3-part dash+slash combo. 3rd cast knocks up.
abilities.W: Ki Burst: AoE stun around self + damage
abilities.E: Valor: dash + shield. Scales with AD.
abilities.R: Blade of the Exile: gain bonus AD + range + enhanced abilities for 15s. Recast: Wind Slash (execute ranged wave).

champions.playstyle: Animation-cancel combo fighter. High mobility + high burst. All AD scaling including shield.

champions.name: Rumble
champions.title: the Mechanized Menace

abilities.P: Junkyard Titan: abilities generate Heat. At 50+, abilities are empowered. At 100, silenced but AAs deal bonus magic.
abilities.Q: Flamespitter: cone of fire dealing magic damage. Empowered: 50% more damage.
abilities.W: Scrap Shield: shield + MS burst. Empowered: 50% more shield + MS.
abilities.E: Electro Harpoon: skillshot slow + magic damage. 2 charges. Empowered: 50% more damage + slow.
abilities.R: The Equalizer: place line of fire (massive zone). Deals magic damage + slow. Incredibly strong zone control.

champions.playstyle: Heat management mage. R Equalizer is one of the best zone ults in game. Stay 50-100 Heat.

champions.name: Ryze
champions.title: the Rune Mage

abilities.P: Arcane Mastery: abilities deal bonus damage based on bonus mana
abilities.Q: Overload: line skillshot. If Flux is on target, spreads. If 2 runes are active, gain shield + MS.
abilities.W: Rune Prison: point-click root. If target is Fluxed, root is longer.
abilities.E: Spell Flux: targeted bounce damage. Spreads Flux to nearby enemies.
abilities.R: Realm Warp: teleport self + nearby allies to target location after channel.

champions.playstyle: Scaling battlemage. Mana scaling = unique builds. EQ combos for spread damage. R for team teleport.

champions.name: Samira
champions.title: the Desert Rose

abilities.P: Daredevil Impulse: build Style (S rank) from unique ability casts. Melee AAs deal bonus magic.
abilities.Q: Flair: ranged skillshot or melee slash depending on range. Fires in direction.
abilities.W: Blade Whirl: spin blades destroying all projectiles (Yasuo windwall but on self). Deals damage.
abilities.E: Wild Rush: dash through enemy/ally. AS boost. Reset on kill.
abilities.R: Inferno Trigger: at S rank only. Spin firing shots at all nearby enemies. Massive AoE DPS. Applies lifesteal.

champions.playstyle: Combo ADC. Build S rank through unique ability casts → R for massive AoE. W blocks projectiles.

champions.name: Senna
champions.title: the Redeemer

abilities.P: Absolution: collect mist from minions/champions. Gain AD + range + crit infinitely.
abilities.Q: Piercing Darkness: long line skillshot. Damages enemies + heals allies in line.
abilities.W: Last Embrace: skillshot root after delay. Root spreads to nearby enemies on death.
abilities.E: Curse of the Black Mist: stealth zone around self. Allies inside become wraiths (camouflage + MS).
abilities.R: Dawning Shadow: global beam dealing damage to enemies + shielding allies hit.

champions.playstyle: Scaling support ADC. Infinite range scaling from mist. Q heals+damages. R global shield/damage.

champions.name: Seraphine
champions.title: the Starry-Eyed Songstress

abilities.P: Stage Presence: every 3rd ability double-casts. Notes from ally abilities empower next AA.
abilities.Q: High Note: AoE skillshot dealing magic damage. More damage to low HP.
abilities.W: Surround Sound: shield + MS to self and nearby allies. If already shielded, heal instead.
abilities.E: Beat Drop: skillshot slow. If target is already slowed, roots. If moving toward, stuns.
abilities.R: Encore: skillshot that extends range through champions hit. Charm + damage. Can chain through team.

champions.playstyle: Teamfight enchanter/mage. R charm chains through enemies. W team shield/heal. Q poke.

champions.name: Sett
champions.title: the Boss

abilities.P: Pit Grit: left punch AA is normal, right punch is faster + bonus damage. Regen between punches.
abilities.Q: Knuckle Down: gain MS toward champs. Next 2 AAs deal bonus damage (+%max HP).
abilities.W: Haymaker: store damage taken as Grit. Recast: AoE punch. Center = true damage based on Grit stored.
abilities.E: Facebreaker: grab enemies on both sides → slam together for stun if grabbed from both sides. Otherwise slow.
abilities.R: The Show Stopper: grab target, suplex them into ground. AoE damage to enemies where you land (based on target's HP).

champions.playstyle: Wrestler juggernaut. W Haymaker true damage based on damage absorbed. R suplex carry into enemy team.

champions.name: Shen
champions.title: the Eye of Twilight

abilities.P: Ki Barrier: after casting ability, gain shield
abilities.Q: Spirit Blade: call spirit blade. AAs through it deal %max HP bonus magic + slow after
abilities.W: Spirit's Refuge: create zone blocking all AAs within. Allies inside can't be auto'd.
abilities.E: Shadow Dash: taunt dash. Enemies hit are taunted + take damage. Restores energy.
abilities.R: Stand United: channel → teleport to ally champion anywhere on map, granting massive shield.

champions.playstyle: Global protector tank. R teleport to save ally anywhere. E taunt for engage. W blocks AAs.

champions.name: Shyvana
champions.title: the Half-Dragon

abilities.P: Fury of the Dragonborn: bonus damage to dragons. AAs generate Fury. AAs on marked targets deal bonus damage.
abilities.Q: Twin Bite: AA reset dealing bonus physical. Dragon: cleave in front.
abilities.W: Burnout: AoE fire trail + bonus MS + on-hit fire. Dragon: larger AoE.
abilities.E: Flame Breath: skillshot fireball marking enemies. AAs on marked deal %max HP magic. Dragon: AoE explosion.
abilities.R: Dragon's Descent: consume Fury to dash and transform into dragon for duration. Gain bonus HP. All abilities enhanced.

champions.playstyle: AP bruiser jungler. Dragon form = massive AoE. E mark → AA for %max HP. Farm Fury for R.

champions.name: Singed
champions.title: the Mad Chemist

abilities.P: Noxious Slipstream: gain MS when near champions
abilities.Q: Poison Trail: toggle: leave poison trail behind dealing magic damage per second
abilities.W: Mega Adhesive: AoE grounding zone + slow. Enemies inside can't dash.
abilities.E: Fling: flip enemy over your shoulder behind you. If thrown into W, root.
abilities.R: Insanity Potion: gain bonus AP, armor, MR, MS, HP regen, mana regen for duration.

champions.playstyle: Proxy farming madman. Run behind enemies, poison trail, flip into team. W grounds dashers.

champions.name: Sion
champions.title: the Undead Juggernaut

abilities.P: Glory in Death: on death, reanimate as zombie with rapid decaying HP. AAs deal %max HP.
abilities.Q: Decimating Smash: charge AoE slam. Longer charge = more damage + knockup (from slow → stun).
abilities.W: Soul Furnace: passive: gain permanent HP from minion kills. Active: shield, recast for AoE damage.
abilities.E: Roar of the Slayer: AoE slow + armor shred. First target knocked back.
abilities.R: Unstoppable Onslaught: charge in direction (unstoppable). Steer slightly. Hit = massive AoE knockup + damage.

champions.playstyle: Infinite HP scaling tank. W passive stacks HP. R cross-map engage. Q charged knockup.

champions.name: Sivir
champions.title: the Battle Mistress

abilities.P: Fleet of Foot: AAs on champions grant MS burst
abilities.Q: Boomerang Blade: throw boomerang dealing physical out + back
abilities.W: Ricochet: next 3 AAs bounce to additional targets. Each bounce deals less damage.
abilities.E: Spell Shield: block next enemy ability. If successful, restore mana.
abilities.R: On the Hunt: grant massive MS to self + nearby allies. Great for engaging/disengaging.

champions.playstyle: Waveclear ADC with team utility. E spell shield for safety. R team MS for engage.

champions.name: Smolder
champions.title: the Fiery Fledgling

abilities.P: Dragon Practice: Q on champions/last hits grants stacks. At thresholds, Q upgrades (AoE, burn, explosion).
abilities.Q: Super Scorcher Breath: main poke. Fires bolt. Evolves at 25/125/225 stacks.
abilities.W: Achooo!: sneeze AoE dealing magic damage + slow
abilities.E: Flap Flap Flap: dash/fly over terrain. Gain MS.
abilities.R: MOOOOM!: call mom for massive AoE fire breath dealing %max HP damage + slow.

champions.playstyle: Infinite-scaling ADC. Farm Q stacks. At 225 = massive AoE explosions. R calls mom for teamfight.

champions.name: Sona
champions.title: Maven of the Strings

abilities.P: Power Chord: every 3 abilities, next AA is empowered (effect depends on last ability used)
abilities.Q: Hymn of Valor: AoE magic damage around nearest enemies. Aura: ally bonus magic damage on next AA.
abilities.W: Aria of Perseverance: heal self + nearby injured ally. Aura: bonus shield.
abilities.E: Song of Celerity: MS boost to self + nearby allies. Aura: bonus MS.
abilities.R: Crescendo: long line AoE stun + magic damage. Forced dance.

champions.playstyle: Scaling enchanter. Auras buff team. R AoE stun. Late game team power is massive.

champions.name: Soraka
champions.title: the Starchild

abilities.P: Salvation: gain MS moving toward low-HP allies
abilities.Q: Starcall: AoE skillshot dealing magic + slow. If hits, Soraka gains Rejuvenation (heal over time).
abilities.W: Astral Infusion: heal ally (costs own HP). If Rejuvenation is active, heals more.
abilities.E: Equinox: AoE silence zone. After delay, roots enemies still inside.
abilities.R: Wish: GLOBAL heal to all allied champions. Increased healing on low-HP targets.

champions.playstyle: Global healer support. W spam heals carry. R heals entire team from anywhere. E silence zone.

champions.name: Swain
champions.title: the Noxian Grand General

abilities.P: Ravenous Flock: pull CC'd enemies toward you + heal. Store soul fragments for bonus HP.
abilities.Q: Death's Hand: AoE bolts in cone. Each bolt through enemy = bonus damage.
abilities.W: Vision of Empire: AoE delayed explosion + slow + reveal. Collect soul fragments.
abilities.E: Nevermove: skillshot root. Recast: pull rooted enemies toward you.
abilities.R: Demonic Ascension: transform into demon form. AoE drain around you. At full charge, recast for AoE burst.

champions.playstyle: Drain-tank battlemage. Pull CC'd enemies. R drain form = massive AoE sustained damage in teamfights.
